summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn, Task.finished_time field, finished property based on finished_time, _reset clears it, capture rules in Progress.update, reset, and advance); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with deferred imports); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry); tests/test_progress.py (test_time_elapsed_column, column added to test_columns, expected frames rewritten); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast). No tests were run because the instructions prohibited running repository code. The test_columns expected output was derived by hand-tracing the clock reads and was checked against the old bar widths (33 and 23), so it is unverified until the test is run. Nothing was committed.
